why: No code path builds the key 'fx_levelup_strip8_512'. The only 'levelup' strings in src are sfx_levelup sound keys (Game1.cs:4509/4653/7397/10532). AssetLibrary.cs:255-262 says the fx_levelup alias was removed and that this file is orphaned. The interpolated fx keys cannot produce it either: fx_{FxKey} uses the catalogue FxKeys {strike, press, trap, mark, projectile, weep, aura, transformation, wilt} (SkillCatalogue.cs), and fx_{championId}_{fxKey}_strip8_512 (HuntScreen.cs:3866/5997) and Warm("fx_"+champion+"_") (HuntScreen.cs:956) always put a champion id in the middle. The VfxProfiles literals never name levelup. It is also EAGER, so it takes 8.4 MB at every boot.
tools: None read the file. tools/asset-pipeline/.staging/v2/vfx/levelup.log.txt is only a generation log. build_spec.py:1001 and animations.json:483 name a different, non-existent key (levelup_gold_purple_strip8_512 in VFX/levelup/gold_purple). asset_usage.sh:12 mentions it in a comment. Deleting the file leaves assets/art/VFX/levelup/ empty.
